import sys

def articulationPoints(V, adj):
    def dfs(at, parent, discovery_times, low_links, visited, articulation_points, time):
        visited[at] = True
        discovery_times[at] = low_links[at] = time
        children = 0
        for neighbor in adj[at]:
            if not visited[neighbor]:
                children += 1
                dfs(neighbor, at, discovery_times, low_links, visited, articulation_points, time + 1)
                low_links[at] = min(low_links[at], low_links[neighbor])
                if parent != -1 and low_links[neighbor] >= discovery_times[at]:
                    articulation_points.add(at)
            elif neighbor != parent:
                low_links[at] = min(low_links[at], discovery_times[neighbor])
        if parent == -1 and children > 1:
            articulation_points.add(at)

    discovery_times = [float('inf')] * V
    low_links = [float('inf')] * V
    visited = [False] * V
    articulation_points = set()

    for i in range(V):
        if not visited[i]:
            dfs(i, -1, discovery_times, low_links, visited, articulation_points, 0)

    return sorted(list(articulation_points)) if articulation_points else [-1]
